installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Koaai installation — NUCLEAR EDITION: no network needed.
# Upload koaai-bundle.tar.gz (built by make-bundle.sh) via the panel,
# or drop loose files (koaai + bin/yt-dlp + bin/node) — that's it.

cd /mnt/server

if [ -f koaai-bundle.tar.gz ]; then
    echo "bundle found - extracting..."
    tar -xzf koaai-bundle.tar.gz -C /mnt/server
elif [ -f koaai ] && [ -f bin/yt-dlp ]; then
    echo "loose files found - using them as-is"
else
    echo "ERROR: upload koaai-bundle.tar.gz (or koaai + bin/) first, then Reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x koaai bin/yt-dlp bin/node 2>/dev/null || true

echo "--- verifying ---"
file koaai | head -1
./bin/yt-dlp --version || { echo "YT-DLP BROKEN"; exit 1; }
./bin/node --version  || { echo "NODE BROKEN"; exit 1; }

echo -e "install complete - nothing was downloaded from the internet"
exit 0
